frozen_at_et_source: python setup/scripts/et_clock.py, run this session (box is Mountain; ET = local+2; never bash TZ)

provenance.why_this_exists: The entry x exit matrix (prereg edc595af) made ATR_STOP the dominant exit column (~$95/tr vs ~$16/tr control). A /fable-too-good audit (backtest/tools/entry_exit_matrix_atr_audit_2026_08_09.py, results in analysis/deep-research/ENTRY-EXIT-MATRIX-ATR-AUDIT-2026-08-09.json) decomposed that gap and found the dynamic width was NOT the driver.

decomposition_that_motivated_this.note: The three components reconcile to the headline exactly. The dynamic component is NEGATIVE: an ATR-computed width is slightly worse than a flat -20% premium stop once the look-ahead is removed.

provenance.walker_parity_cleared: walk_lane_dynamic_shape reproduces sl.walk_lane's CONTROL cell exactly ($16.06/tr, n=289, delta $0.00), so the twin walker is faithful and cross-engine divergence (the SIM-EXIT-SHAPE-PARITY scar) is ruled out as the explanation.
provenance.post_hoc_disclosure: The stop_mode axis was NOT pre-registered in edc595af. Everything above is post-hoc and is treated as hypothesis-generating ONLY. This document freezes the hypothesis BEFORE any confirmatory runner is written, which is the whole point of filing it.

hypothesis: On the ribbon_ride population, exit_shape.stop_mode='premium' (structure_stop_enabled=False, flat premium_stop_pct=-0.20) produces higher per-trade expectancy than the as-shipped stop_mode='structure', across both the historical replay population and the real-fills book.
mechanism_under_test: Structure/ribbon invalidation is a LAGGING exit (already C28 in the lessons index: L139,141,156,157,175,243). The claim is that it exits winners early on flip-back noise AND rides losers past -20% before invalidating, and that a hard premium stop cuts losers faster while leaving winners to the chandelier trail. The falsifiable signature is: WR should FALL while total P&L RISES. If WR rises too, the mechanism story is wrong even if the dollars look good.

arms.CONTROL: exit_shape exactly as fleet_strategies.by_name('ribbon_ride').exit (stop_mode=structure, premium_stop_pct=-0.20, catastrophe_stop_pct=-0.50, tp1=+100%/0.667, trail 0.15, arm +0.05, arm_scope post_tp1)
arms.PREMIUM_20: identical in every field EXCEPT stop_mode='premium' (which sets structure_stop_enabled=False). One variable.
arms.PREMIUM_20_CAP60: as PREMIUM_20 but catastrophe_stop_pct=-0.60, included because the matrix showed cap-widening was directionally positive within structure mode; guards against attributing a cap effect to the mode.

populations: A: 399-trading-day replay 2025-01-02..2026-08-07, all 8 pre-registered entry rows from the matrix, real cached OPRA fills only, sequential one-position NOT_FLAT walk, exits via exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager -> exit_manager.plan_exit_actions (never simulator_real).

B: 244 real broker-truth engine-attributed option-buy fills over 27 trading days (2026-06-26..2026-08-07) from analysis/entry-quality/entry-quality-ledger.json, re-walked through the identical exit engine. LADDER7/8/9 and ZONE are n/a by construction (a realized fill carries no score/blocker/level-scan record).
battery_per_cell: sub-window stability: chronological halves, sign-consistency of expectancy
Tuesday 2026-08-04 no-harm HARD GATE, reported per cell; where the row admits zero trades that date, reported as NOT EVALUABLE, never as a pass
BH-FDR q=0.10 across every cell tested in this study
kill_criteria: Population A and population B disagree in sign on the PREMIUM_20 vs CONTROL delta -> report the disagreement as the finding; do NOT pick a winner.
The mechanism signature fails (WR does not fall while P&L rises) -> the dollar result is treated as unexplained and does not advance.
drop-best-day expectancy for PREMIUM_20 goes negative -> single-day artifact, killed.
Sub-window instability in either population -> killed.

ship_rule.why: Three independent reasons, stated in advance so a good result cannot talk me out of them. (1) The Tuesday 2026-08-04 anchor is not evaluable on the CONTROL entry row (zero admitted trades that date), so anchor_no_regression cannot be satisfied. (2) No walk-forward efficiency is computed here, so the OP-11 auto-ratify bar (OOS positive AND WF >= 0.70 AND sub-window stable AND anchor no-regression) is not met. (3) The change reverses explicitly ratified doctrine (chart-stop-primary, 2026-06-18), which is a doctrine decision and not an exit-grid side effect.
ship_rule.what_this_run_produces_instead: A filed A/B scorecard at analysis/recommendations/stop-mode-structure-vs-premium-2026-08-09.json and a REVOKE-surfaced recommendation. No edit to automation/state/params.json, automation/state/fleet/*, filters.py, or any live trading-path file.
ship_rule.explicitly_forbidden_tonight: Flipping the primary stop mechanism on the live path the evening before a trading week, on a post-hoc replay finding.

no_look_ahead: Both arms are static shapes known at entry; neither reads any post-entry bar to set a parameter. This is the specific defect found in ATR_STOP and it is structurally absent here.
reporting_rule: Every cell reported, no top-N truncation, including cells that fail. Nulls are results and get written down -- the dynamic-stop null from 2026-07-07 went unrecorded and cost weeks of re-discovery (see memory: dynamic-exits-not-fixed-caps).
evidence: Kill criterion #2 ('mechanism signature fails -> unexplained, does not advance') fired independently on THREE separate instruments: (1) retrospective real-fills population B (244 fills, 27 days): 4/4 rows positive in dollars but ZERO BH-FDR survivors and win rate does NOT fall (mechanism 0/4). (2) paired shadow ledger (stop_mode_shadow_ledger.py, re-run 2026-09-05): n_days=18/20 accrual target, n_trades=206, cum_delta=-$956.10, mean=-$4.64/trade, mechanism_signature_holds=false, wr_control=34.5% vs wr_premium=29.6% (WR FELL under premium, consistent direction but net dollars now NEGATIVE not positive -- the forward read has flipped sign from the earlier retrospective). (3) the live single-arm trial (risky-3, see STOP-MODE-LIVE-ARM-RISKY3-2026-08-09 adjudication, same fire) was retired 2026-08-28 for the identical reason. All three independent readings now agree: premium-mode does not beat structure-mode on this book. Population A's (399-day replay, no look-ahead) +$24-61/trade positive result stands as a REPLAY-ONLY finding that failed to replicate forward -- doctrine (chart-stop-primary, 2026-06-18) is correctly not reversed. Ledger continues accruing (2 more days to its own n=20 bar) but the sign and magnitude now argue against, not for, this hypothesis; no forward A/B should be proposed on this axis.
